proposed.text: William Rawlins, who had David Lieberman hunted down for leaking the Cerberus footage, learns David is still alive and has his wife and son kidnapped.

changes.evidence: Rawlins found out David was the leaker before the story starts and had Carson Wolf deal with him. In S1#11 Rawlins has Sarah and Zach Lieberman kidnapped, and when Russo asks, he says Wolf told him David had been killed. The current text puts the discovery in S1#11 and leaves out the kidnapping, which is what actually happens between them there.

owner_calls.question: Should this connection stay? Daniel Blake and Matt Murdock never seem to meet on screen. Blake spreads Fisk's line against Daredevil: in S1#7 he makes BB cut mentions of Daredevil, and in S2#1 he gets out the claim that the Northern Star was a Daredevil terror attack.
options: Keep it: Blake's propaganda has big consequences for Matt (title moves to S2#1)
Drop it: Blake only knows about Daredevil (N7)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's Blake biography never has him speak to Matt. They are both in the room at the Black & White Ball (S1#8) but do not interact. Every Blake act involving Daredevil is media spin done on Fisk's orders.
